# Synthetic fixtures only

`echo-native.mjs` is an intentionally simple protocol fixture, not a Bazi,
Zi Wei Dou Shu, Meihua, calendar, or true-solar-time engine. Its intentionally
broken modes are fault injections. No actual user identities, birth data,
relationship histories, or prior consultation records are included.

`syntheticCard()` does not document a real tradition. It is used only to test
knowledge-card structure, references, prerequisites, and rejection behavior.
